title: Chameleon Races Rabbit
subtitle: Reading Practice
tagline: A folktale from the Lomwe people of Mozambique.

voiceSample: Chameleon challenged Rabbit to a race.

s: One day, Chameleon challenged Rabbit to a race to see who was faster.
Rabbit accepted, saying, "You are so slow!"
"You start with one foot, then stop and start with the other."
"You will never even arrive."
"I will leave you far, far behind."
"You won't even see me!"
So, they invited all the animals to come and watch.
Chameleon and Rabbit lined up and waited for the signal.
When the race began, Chameleon jumped onto Rabbit's tail.
As Rabbit ran off, the animals laughed and clapped their hands.
They were laughing like crazy because Chameleon was on Rabbit's tail.
Hearing the noise, Rabbit skidded to a stop.
Chameleon jumped off and said, "Hey! Watch where you're going!"
"It's about time you got here."
Rabbit was amazed and started running again.
As they approached the finish line, the animals clapped their hands, shouting to see Chameleon still on Rabbit's tail.
Rabbit heard them and thought Chameleon must have already won.
When they arrived at the finish line, Chameleon jumped off and said, "Don't step on me!"
"I got here first!"
Rabbit stormed off in a temper.
Chameleon stayed to receive the prize, and Rabbit lost.

words.en: a lizard that can change its colour
a contest to see who is fastest
the long part at the back of an animal
a sign that tells you to start

quiz.q: Who challenged Rabbit to a race?
Where did Chameleon ride during the race?
How did Rabbit feel at the end?
